answer: Trust can spread like a vine from a seed grove: a few audited agents vouch for others, and trust flows outward along vouch edges, split and attenuated at each hop. A sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, yet they join the honest graph through only a few attack edges, so total trust entering the cluster is capped by those edges, not its size. More fake names gain nothing; the attacker must corrupt real bonded vouchers, a ferrous, heavy cost since their stake is slashed when caught.
